status: Planning baseline; no implementation or delivered capability claimed
authority: Owner requested customer-visible milestones toward V1 feature parity, decomposing only M01; accepted Spike 01/local scope and explicit owner policies remain.
goal: A dependable localhost-only successor to V1 on Go, TypeScript and SQLite.

milestones.title: Work across projects and boards in one local workspace
milestones.done: Open one localhost workspace, select any of three synthetic boards across two projects, see truthful counts for supported Attention categories, use shared pins, and switch/reload without losing or misapplying private work. Missing lane categories are explicitly not configured until M02.

milestones.title: Complete daily card work through browser and CLI
milestones.done: Reach the remaining documented daily card outcomes: usable card detail and committed history, search/filter, rename, hierarchy and typed links, archive/unarchive, configurable workflow and keyboard-friendly interaction. Preserve explicit priority and human acceptance.
milestones.planningLevel: High level only; define detailed acceptance and any deliberate V1 differences before implementation.

milestones.title: Manage attachments and cover images in ordinary use
milestones.done: Add, inspect, download and remove attachments and choose/clear covers through ordinary product controls; bytes, attribution, history, references and export/restore remain consistent.
milestones.planningLevel: High level only; no attachment-storage rewrite or new limits selected.

milestones.title: Operate the local tool and its optional automation reliably
milestones.done: Restore useful monitor alerts with bot-only suppression, explicit targets and delivery state, optional Git-readable publishing/backup and maintainable local update/restart behavior. Board saves remain independent of optional delivery/publishing.
milestones.planningLevel: High level only; explicitly opt-in external publishing/notifications, no message sending or remote credentials authorized now.

milestones.title: Bring a V1 board into V2 without losing its work
milestones.done: Demonstrate read-only inventory/dry-run and isolated JSON-to-SQLite import with card IDs/tickets, actors, policy, relationships, history and exact attachment bytes accounted for; prove coexistence and a usable recovery path.
milestones.planningLevel: High level only; synthetic rehearsal first. Named real sources/destinations and any activation/cutover require later explicit owner authorization.

milestones.title: Accept feature parity and a maintainable everyday release
milestones.done: Reconcile the V1 capability matrix against delivered behavior and owner-approved intentional changes; demonstrate an ordinary multi-board browser/CLI workflow, restart/recovery, backup/restore and optional operations on the final candidate.
milestones.planningLevel: High level only; no full-parity claim until evidence closes every retained outcome and the owner accepts it.

m01Tasks.title: Freeze the workspace contract and parity checkpoint
acceptance: Document a small integration contract for project/board addressing, configured roots, discovery/registration/create behavior, hosting/lifecycle, API/CLI selection, shared pins and per-window recovery. Use /board/<project>/<board> navigation; distinguish the V1 planning boards from V2 SQLite data.

Reuse accepted Go authority/storage/recovery and TS view modules. Choose the least complicated hosting/adapter composition that preserves one writer per board; record actual file ownership and required contract extensions. No new framework, TLS, accounts or workflow engine.

Freeze a three-board/two-project acceptance fixture and a retained/remaining/intentional-difference matrix from the V1 public README and accepted Spike 01. Include startup, unavailable board, counts, pins/two windows and pending operation during navigation. Current qualified lanes are Ready for Work/In Progress/Ready for Review/Completed. M01 must not add configurable workflow states; unsupported Attention categories are not configured, not fabricated zero.
Fresh independent contract review precedes owner handoff. Consequential choices not already authorized must be explicit in the finished proposal; downstream cards wait for accepted contract.
m01Tasks.boundedScope: Workspace contract and acceptance matrix; no product implementation.
m01Tasks.ownership: docs/decisions workspace contract and public parity matrix

m01Tasks.title: Host and reopen independent boards under configured projects
acceptance: Implement configured project/board discovery or explicit registration and synthetic board initialization according to the accepted contract. Three boards across two projects remain separately identifiable and persistent.

Exactly one authoritative writer owns each board. Repeated selection, restart, duplicate registration or a second host cannot create a second writer or silently replace a store/identity. Preserve the existing one-board entry.
A missing, invalid, busy or unavailable board has an explicit status while healthy boards remain usable. No automatic V1 JSON adoption, repair, grant expansion or real-data migration.
Run focused host/lifecycle checks on real supported filesystem/loopback boundaries, with fresh non-author review before handoff.
m01Tasks.boundedScope: Go workspace registry and lifecycle integration; no browser shell or importer.
m01Tasks.ownership: Go workspace host/registry plus local runtime integration

m01Tasks.title: Project truthful workspace Attention and board health
acceptance: Expose board keys/labels, current identity/revision, availability/freshness and truthful counts for categories supported by the current four-lane policy, including Ready for Review. Blocked/Needs Terry are explicitly not configured until M02, not fabricated zero. Archived cards do not inflate counts.

Use two projects and three boards with distinct supported-state counts to prove projection membership. Known zero, not configured, stale last-known data and unavailable/unknown remain distinguishable; no failed query becomes a current zero.
Membership disclosure and projections reuse the local authority boundary. A pin or URL grants no board right. Catalog reads never mutate cards, assigned priority or approval.

Freeze deterministic activity/ordering rules in the accepted contract; preserve stable ties and avoid inventing cross-board atomicity or new urgency scoring. Independently review actual adapter behavior.
m01Tasks.boundedScope: Go catalog/projection and focused tests; no search, hierarchy or publishing.
m01Tasks.ownership: Go workspace catalog/projection and boundary contracts

m01Tasks.title: Select and use the correct board through the actual CLI
acceptance: Provide focused project/board list/selection and initialization commands from the accepted contract. Existing single-board --data invocation continues to work.
Actual built CLI operations address the deliberately selected board only. Ambiguous, missing or unavailable targets refuse visibly; never fall back to the last/default board or direct SQL writes.
Show current identity/revision and readable/machine-distinguishable outcomes. Preserve automation-only CLI authority and existing original-operation lookup/no-replay behavior.
With two same-ticket boards, create/edit/comment on A and prove B unchanged; switch explicitly to B and repeat. Run real local CLI checks and obtain fresh independent review.
m01Tasks.boundedScope: Go CLI selection adapter and ordinary CLI evidence; no human approval channel.
m01Tasks.ownership: cmd/localswim and CLI workspace selection adapters

m01Tasks.title: Navigate the workspace through the normal browser
acceptance: Build project/board sidebar and Attention display using the real catalog. Use labels/full counts and keyboard selection; preserve useful board space and show errors/retry without blocking healthy boards.
Support /board/<project>/<board> direct links, normal Back/Forward, another window and switching without a full document reload. Unknown links show unavailable and never select another board.

Board rendering and edit controls remain bound to the selected stable identity. Preserve focus and existing editor input during harmless refresh; a delayed A response cannot paint or dispatch against B.
Demonstrate ordinary DOM selection among all three boards and cross-client shared state. Retain the existing single-board journey; fresh non-author review before handoff.
m01Tasks.boundedScope: TS workspace shell/router and catalog integration; no new card feature set.
m01Tasks.ownership: TS workspace shell/navigation and board composition

m01Tasks.title: Share pins while keeping each window independent
acceptance: Implement pin/unpin/manual reorder with server-persisted preferences scoped to the workspace. Pins/order survive browser and host restart and appear in a second window.
Use revision-conflict handling for simultaneous preference edits; failed saves are visible and never silently claim persistence. Preferences do not alter board revisions or grant membership/approval.
Keep active board, sidebar view state, focus and scroll per window; shared pin refresh must not steal another window's route or editor. Keyboard pin/reorder controls remain usable.
Demonstrate two windows with different active boards, shared reordered pins, one failed/stale preference save, refresh and restart. Obtain fresh independent review.
m01Tasks.boundedScope: Workspace preferences plus bounded TS pin controls; no device/account sync platform.
m01Tasks.ownership: Go workspace preferences and TS pin/window-state controls

m01Tasks.title: Preserve drafts and original outcomes across board navigation
acceptance: Reuse existing private draft/original-submission stores with full board/installation/incarnation/actor context. Switching A to B cannot expose, overwrite, clear or submit A's private input as B.
Reload/back/forward and two windows recover the correct per-board input/base. A late A mutation response while B is active cannot replace B prose/focus or resolve an unrelated submission.

Reconnect/host restart refreshes selection/authority without replay. Immutable original lookup stays with its original board/context/fingerprint; unavailable or replaced source remains UNKNOWN, not inferred noncommit.

Actual browser/CLI fault scenarios cover cross-board late response, pending-original navigation, storage denial and explicit discard scope. Preserve the qualified single-board behavior and obtain fresh recovery/authority review.
m01Tasks.boundedScope: Workspace recovery coordination only; no rewrite of the journal, retention policy or authority transfer.
m01Tasks.ownership: TS workspace/session/recovery coordination and narrow adapter wiring

m01Tasks.title: Qualify the complete multi-board customer journey
acceptance: Freeze mandatory actual product cases for two projects/three boards: create/select/read/write, Attention known-zero versus failure, pins/two windows, bookmarks/Back/Forward, navigation with drafts/pending originals, restart and healthy-board isolation.

Run the built CLI and normal browser controls against fresh synthetic SQLite data. Preserve the existing 21-case single-board inventory and negative bot-approval/premature-start checks; mocks are not positive end-to-end evidence.

Bind current sources, generated assets, executable and tools to raw results; keep failed attempts and owned teardown. Refresh affected native lifecycle/durability checks when the new host changes those boundaries; do not relabel old PASS.

Publish the delivered-capability matrix, remaining gaps and exact reproduction command. Proportionate focused checks precede the full milestone journey; no benchmark or elaborate qualification platform.
m01Tasks.boundedScope: Mandatory integration qualification and capability report, not new product implementation.
m01Tasks.ownership: qualification/workspace plus browser/native inventories as actually affected

m01Tasks.title: Demonstrate M01 and independently review the handoff
acceptance: Demonstrate one normal localhost workspace with three boards across two projects, including multiple boards within one project, truthful Attention, shared pins and isolated per-window/board work. State delivered capability separately from completed cards.

A fresh non-author independently verifies the complete workflow and actual evidence, including preserved SQLite ownership and human/bot boundaries. Required source/build/asset checks pass on the final candidate.

Publish PASS or actionable Changes Required with material findings, deliberate limitations and a concise startup/use/recovery note. A separate non-author validates the final review report before publication.
Only owner review remains at handoff. Preserve owner-controlled Completed and hold M02 implementation until its own later decomposition/acceptance; no live import/cutover is part of M01.
m01Tasks.boundedScope: Final milestone demonstration, independent review and owner handoff; no new features.
m01Tasks.ownership: qualification/workspace final review/report and user run sheet

globalConstraints: Browser AND CLI use the same numeric-loopback HTTP authority; no LAN/TLS/enrollment ceremony.
P3 default; assigned priority is not raised by graph position. Preserve human-only approval and Completed, SQLite durability and original UNKNOWN/no replay.
V1 public documented outcomes are the baseline; intentional departures need a concrete benefit and owner acceptance. Old candidate architecture that conflicts with the localhost reset is historical.
Only M01 is decomposed/eligible for future execution under its recorded prerequisites. Later milestone cards are high-level roadmap, not authorized implementation.
No real V1 board import, activation, external message delivery or live cutover is authorized by this planning task.
Fresh non-author review before each handoff; move each selected card In Progress first. Four active direct subagents/depth one conservatively retained; planned assignments reserve no slots.

M01 keeps the qualified four-lane policy. Full configurable lanes/Blocked/Needs Terry parity belongs to M02; unsupported Attention categories remain explicitly not configured. No hidden reverse dependency from M01 to M02.
sources: ../design/17-workspace.txt (candidate detail only where consistent with current owner scope)
v1Baseline: V1 public README: Multiple boards in one workspace; Daily use; Archiving cards; Card attachments and cover photos; Data safety and Git; Live code updates; Shared board-write monitor. Documentation only; no V1 implementation/tests copied.
currentCapability: Spike 01 is owner-accepted; one-board runtime and bounded final qualification passed. No complete V1 parity, deployment or migration claim.
